newsitem.title: USA: Iowa's Gov. Branstad will not seek fifth term.
newsitem.headline: Iowa's Gov. Branstad will not seek fifth term.

text.p: Gov. Terry Branstad, who has served longer than any governor, says he has decided not to seek a fifth term.
"I made the decision not to run for re-election," he said in a broacast interview aired last weekend.
The Republican chief executive was elected to a fourth term in 1994. During that campaign he said it would be his last. But in recent months he gave some indication he might change his mind.
Branstad said in the interview that he would back Sen. Charles Grassley, R-Iowa, for the post if Grassley want to run.
Iowa's other senator, Democrat Tom Harkin, has also been the subject of speculation as a possible gubernatorial candidate. Harkin last month called that speculation premature.
